title: refactor(ci): consolidate Node workflows, upgrade Node to 20, and tidy deps
author: Aisha Patel
description:
Motivation: our repository has accumulated multiple GitHub Actions workflows targeting different Node versions and per-repo lint/test pipelines. This increases maintenance burden, causes duplicated caching logic, and contributes to CI minutes and flaky matrix permutations. This PR consolidates the Node-related workflows into a single reusable pipeline, upgrades the default Node runtime to v20, pins/updates several actions, and tidies up dependency-related steps.

What this PR does (summary):
- Introduces .github/workflows/ci.yml as the consolidated CI pipeline that uses reusable workflows and job matrices sparingly.
- Removes older per-repo Node-specific workflow files (lint-node16.yml, test-node18.yml) and replaces them with calls to the consolidated workflow.
- Upgrades setup-node usage to actions/setup-node@v4 and sets default node-version: 20.
- Pins commonly used actions (actions/checkout, actions/cache, actions/upload-artifact) to stable SHAs where possible.
- Standardizes cache keys and reduces redundant restores; adds partial restore fallback to mitigate cache corruption flakiness.
- Consolidates lint and unit-test steps into a single job with separate steps to avoid duplicated install/setup time.
- Keeps integration/e2e jobs as separate, long-running jobs but reuses the same checkout/cache logic.
- Updates release automation to use a centralized reusable workflow (release/release-drafter.yml) and removes duplicated release-drafter configs across subfolders.
- Minor housekeeping: removes obsolete Node 16 references, updates README CI section, and adds a short migration note for on-call.

Risk & rollout: non-breaking. The change is behind feature gates for a couple of repositories that still need custom behavior; for those we kept per-repo overrides and added a compatibility path. CI coverage and E2E were run across the monorepo before merging (see checks).

Testing done: full CI run, targeted rerun of flaky test suite, and a smoke deploy of release-drafter for a dry-run. See CI checks below for details.

References: Linear ENG-6237 (CI refactor project), INFRA-112 (Action pinning), related PRs: pr-41238, pr-42501 for prior workflow hygiene.

merge_commit_message:
refactor(ci): consolidate Node workflows, upgrade node to 20, pin actions and tidy deps

Consolidates multiple per-repo Node workflows into a single reusable CI pipeline and upgrades default Node to 20. Pins common actions, standardizes caching, and removes legacy Node16/18-only workflows.
release_notes: Consolidated GitHub Actions workflows and CI improvements: default Node runtime upgraded to v20, pinned actions, reduced CI duplication and improved cache stability. No runtime/API changes. Follow the migration note in README.md if you maintain repo-specific CI customizations.
notes_for_oncall: If CI starts failing after merge, check cache key integrity and restore fallback behavior in tools/ci/reusable-workflows/checkout-and-cache.yml. Revert path: revert the squash merge commit and re-enable previous per-repo workflow files as a short-term mitigation.
